222-527-6798-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6798-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2210-2459-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirrormade trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirrormade.
Repeat.
708-2210-2459-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2921-4699.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

5658-6245-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
5658-6245-6753-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
5658-6245-6753-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

104-2685-3263-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2685-3263-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

6676-7666.notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
6676-7666.description:
Donate Demonic Pact to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
3644-5231-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

206-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-7297.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1409-2557-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3967-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1659-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1477-3661-5220-6900.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6638.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-5231-6638.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Tidus triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-3817-5256-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

488-641-1414-2478-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Lotus Petal or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1414-2478-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

225-1846-3525.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1846-3525.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat from step 2

2681-5475-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2681-5475-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
2681-5475-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1978-2734-5116.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

147-413-1223.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
147-413-1223.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing that much damage to any target(s).

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

3967-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
3967-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 4.

1032-4067-5467.easyPrerequisites: Power of Fire attached to Wylie Duke.
1032-4067-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
1032-4067-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

1637-3946-4935.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2218-2459-4763-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2218-2459-4763-5147.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Rograkh.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1703-3542-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1703-3542-4050.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Palinchron, adding one mana of any color.
Fool's Demise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning Fool's Demise to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, targeting Palinchron.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

803-3252-4508-5184.description:
Activate Shivan Hellkite by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

893-1651-4365.description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Myr tokens, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

586-1636-1921.notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
586-1636-1921.description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, sacrificing two artifact tokens, and exiling Priest of Gix from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
The Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Priest of Gix token, and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite black mana, you may instead choose any other artifact token(s) to make infinite copies of them.

710-1703-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

232-1235-3368-4863.description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask.
Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield triggers.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Reiterate from your graveyard to hand.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2281-2399-4871.description:
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it targeting Colfenor.
Colfenor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Let the Colfenor trigger resolve, declining to return anything.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter ability, creating a delayed trigger that will return Colfenor to the battlefield when it dies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Colfenor, adding {C}{C}.
Colfenor, Pitiless Plunderer, and Saffi Eriksdotter trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning Saffi Eriksdotter to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi Eriksdotter trigger, returning Colfenor to the battlefield.
Cast Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing the two Treasure tokens.
Repeat.

292-1495-4948.notablePrerequisites:
Triskelion has at least 2 +1/+1 counters on it.
Estrid's Invocation is a copy of Rite of Passage.
292-1495-4948.description:
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Triskelion to deal 1 damage to Triskelion.
The Rite of Passages trigger, putting 2 +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat for infinite +1/+1 counters.
End the turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Remove infinite counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage.
